title: VLA-FAIL: Efficient Task Failure Detection for Finetuned Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2606.21386v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) achieve state-of-the-art performance on many robotic manipulation tasks, yet they can still behave unpredictably in out-of-distribution scenarios. Runtime failure detection is therefore essential for the safe real-world deployment of VLAs.However, existing task failure detectors require computationally expensive action sampling, are based on architectural assumptions that limit their applicability to VLAs, or need access to failure rollouts. We propose VLA-FAIL, a lightweight and broadly applicable failure detection framework for VLAs that combines two novel failure detectors with minimal overhead, without requiring failure data. The first, last-layer Mahalanobis distance (LLMD), detects out-of-distribution states by measuring token-wise deviations in last-layer features relative to the training data. translated_title: VLA-FAIL：面向微调视觉-语言-动作模型的高效任务失败检测
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）在许多机器人操作任务上取得了最先进的性能，但在分布外场景中仍可能表现出不可预测的行为。因此，运行时失败检测对于VLA在现实世界中的安全部署至关重要。然而，现有的任务失败检测器要么需要计算成本高昂的动作采样，要么基于限制其适用于VLA的架构假设，要么需要访问失败回放数据。我们提出VLA-FAIL，这是一个轻量级且广泛适用的VLA失败检测框架，它结合了两个新颖的失败检测器，开销极小且无需失败数据。第一个是最后一层马氏距离（LLMD），通过测量最后一层特征中相对于训练数据的逐token偏差来检测分布外状态。第二个是动作块一致性（ACC），利用滚动时域动作分块所带来的时间重叠来检测失败。
tldr: 提出VLA-FAIL框架，通过最后一层马氏距离（LLMD）和动作块一致性（ACC）两个轻量级检测器，在无需失败数据和最小开销的情况下高效检测视觉-语言-动作模型的运行时任务失败。
en_tdlr: VLA-FAIL is a lightweight, broadly applicable failure detection framework for vision-language-action models that combines last-layer Mahalanobis distance (LLMD) and action chunk consistency (ACC) to efficiently detect runtime task failures with minimal overhead and without requiring failure data.
